column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Kederon elder battle
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: These lot... are better than I expected!
If this keeps up, my long-cherished wish...
to die on the battlefield may finally be granted...!!
Interesting...
It's been a long time since I was this well entertained!!
W-what are these old men?!
T-they're strong...!!
Don't underestimate us as mere old men!
Everyone here...
were battle-hardened warriors who once roamed the battlefield!!
We won't be taken down by pups like you just yet!
Hey! We're...
not from this village...!
We know that perfectly well!
Our village isn't in such an unhurried state that we can worry about that!
Anyway, young people...
Unless we gather young people, the village will collapse...
and the paradise we worked so hard to create...
You lot, calm down a little!!
Who the hell are you?!
If you're an old man, act like one... Take the old men's side!
How rude!!
Lord $$ヨハネ$$ is nowhere near as old as you are!
